consistency: Verify a completed bounded batch; no concurrent multi-file snapshot publication claim.
atomicity: Native file output commit; partial files during an unfinished/failed job are not qualified as a published dataset.
idempotency: errorifexists prevents silently replacing existing output; interrupted publication retry is pending.
durability: Shared Docker volume on one host; executors can recompute input, storage is not replicated.
retry: Native Spark task retry policy; no automatic replay of whole application writes.
payload: 1,000,000 order rows joined to 10,000 customers; 16 input partitions for recovery run.
client: PySpark supported engine API; independent Arrow 26.0.1 row oracle. One core and 1 GiB advertised per executor.
